notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
RID cycling via Bash loop with rpcclient queryuser: increments RIDs from 500 to 1100 and retrieves account details for each valid RID. Bypasses enumdomusers restriction — queryuser is often permitted even when full user listing is blocked.

=== RID MAP ===
500 = built-in Administrator, 501 = Guest, 502 = KRBTGT (DC only), 1000+ = created domain users and groups. RIDs are sequential, predictable, and complete — no accounts are missed.

=== CHAINING ===
rpcclient null session → attempt enumdomusers (may be blocked) → fallback to RID cycling → collect all usernames → feed to password spray.
